name: Stronger Together
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Haas-Bioroid: Stronger Together, the Revised Core Set's Haas-Bioroid identity, whose bioroid ice has +1 strength, and four of the set's ice: Hive, which loses an “End the run.” for each of the Corp's agenda points, Caduceus's two traces, Yagura and Himitsu-Bako. Eight bioroids — Ansel 1.0, Eli 1.0, Hákarl 1.0, Viktor 1.0 and Týr — on Retirement Package's frame, its 21 points in Midnight-3 Arcology where it holds Vulnerability Audit, with the four splashes for 14 of its 15 influence. Eternal-legal only: Stronger Together is a Revised Core Set card. FFG F1 Stage 3. FFG F1 Stage 4: two Green Level Clearance for its two Corporate Hospitality, an operation for an operation; Ash 2X3ZB9CY and Strongbox for its two Experiential Data, an upgrade for an upgrade; and three Project Ares for its two Project Vacheron, the same 6 points in one more card, which has the Runner trash an install for each counter past 4. Retirement Package keeps all three. FFG F1 Stage 6: two Hudson 1.0 for its two Viktor 1.0, a bioroid for a bioroid, whose subroutines leave the Runner one card to access for the rest of the run. Retirement Package keeps Viktor. Kitara Stage 4a: two Ikawah Project for three Midnight-3 Arcology, the same six points. Kitara Stage 5a: two Riot Suppression for two Big Deal. Warden Fatuma for Adonis Campaign: a bioroid deck whose ice takes the granted subroutine
